requests.what: Adopt the memo graph's one shadow selector as stated in N28b-38 (which BD-111 depends on and which implements it in shadow.rs): per-NODE durable hit ordinal n and phase p = low six bits of BLAKE3(kind, kind version, key), shadow when (n + p) mod 64 = 0. The per-kind ordinal with a phase from the kind starves keys whose hits recur with a period sharing a factor with 64: two keys of one kind requested alternately (an agent re-checking designs A and B) put all of one key's hits on even ordinals and the other's on odd, so one of them is never shadowed. Tests shadow_window_has_exactly_one and shadow_ordinal_survives_restart become per node. Also its store-policy paragraph says 'the policy bead is BD-220; until then LRU': eviction is N33c-18/N33c-19 at M1 under N28b-38's clause.

Its shadow paragraph cites N28b-38's selector as 'hashes the key with the node's hit ordinal'; N28b-38 now states it exactly (phase from BLAKE3(kind, version, key), rate from the per-node durable ordinal, (n + p) mod 64 = 0): each class's shared node is shadowed exactly once per 64 of its member hits.
